## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits; each commit builds and passes its tests on its own
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / testkit / e2e / chaos, as needed)
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation updated in the same commit, or the commit message says `Docs-Not-Needed: <reason>`
- [ ] New user-visible errors have registered error codes
- [ ] New metrics are registered and documented
- [ ] Compatibility impact explained when `pipeforge-api`, a protocol or a state format changes
- [ ] Source files carry the license header; new dependencies use whitelisted licenses
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
